items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: And he, he liked to imitate Bobby Hackett, that kind of stuff, you know, sort of late Chicago smooth stuff.

ctx.x: And I remember the fellow, the fellow, we had a little band in school, you know, and I played trombone on it at that time. I used to play trombone. And he, he liked to imitate Bobby Hackett, that kind of stuff, you know, sort of late Chicago smooth stuff. And we played the odd job, again, at high school dances. And I remember he played me a Bunk Johnson record once and I asked him about the clarinet player, Lewis, and he said, oh yes, Lewis. Never heard the name. I was very impressed that he knew the name of…
They just got sort of tired of playing or something?
